input.topic: Why walking 8,000 steps a day beats a 30-minute HIIT class for most desk workers

hook: You cannot sit for eight hours and fix it with one HIIT class.
body:
Sitting at your desk for eight hours straight—staring at a screen—puts your metabolism into a deep freeze.

A sudden, thirty-minute HIIT class just spikes your stress hormones, makes you crash, and leaves you craving sugar.

Spreading out eight thousand steps—with three short ten-minute walks during your breaks—keeps your fat-burning enzymes turned on all day.
cta: Comment your average daily step count below.

meta.angle: Constant low-intensity movement like walking prevents the metabolic slowdown caused by prolonged sitting, which a single intense workout cannot fix.
